data.title: 伽玛 · 更衣室的战服拉链
data.description: 训练结束的更衣室里，伽玛背靠金属柜门拉开史莱姆战服的前襟散热，汗水顺着锁骨滑下。理论满分的她今天又摔了三跤——但拉链拉开的那一刻，精灵的身段可一点都不“最弱”。
data.location: 阴影庭园训练场更衣室
data.action: 背靠更衣柜拉开战服拉链，大汗淋漓，仰头喘息
data.lighting: yellow work lamps and a shaft of daylight in the locker room
data.promptProse: In the training ground locker room, adult Gamma leans against the lockers and unzips her slime bodysuit to cool down, sweat tracing her collarbone after another fall-filled practice.
data.animaCaption: She unzips against the cold metal, breathless — the weakest Shadow, everywhere except on paper.
